stemMd: A task requires 90 minutes of uninterrupted work. Available periods are 09:00–09:40, 10:00–11:20 and 13:15–14:50. Which period can accommodate it?
explanationMd: The three durations are forty, eighty and ninety-five minutes. Only the last is at least ninety minutes long. Because the work must be uninterrupted, separate shorter periods cannot be combined.

distractorRationale.c: Neither morning period reaches ninety minutes.
distractorRationale.b: The afternoon period lasts ninety-five minutes.
